 Match Preview
 AFC Champions League Elite - Game Week 4 3 Nov 2026 - 05:15 Port FC host Beijing Guoan in the AFC Champions League Elite, with both clubs in contrasting positions as the group stage continues.
 Port FC are in a difficult spot in the East group standings, sitting near the bottom and facing the prospect of an early exit from the continental competition. Their AFC campaign has been rough, and they will need a result here to keep any hopes alive.
 Coach Sarawut Treephan's side have shown they can produce results in Thai League action, but their performances in the AFC Champions League Elite have told a different story. Getting anything from this fixture would represent a significant turnaround.
 Beijing Guoan arrive in considerably better shape. Under coach Nick Montgomery, the Chinese side have been picking up points consistently and sit comfortably in the upper half of the East standings.
 Montgomery's men drew their last AFC outing against Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors, but their domestic form has been strong, with a run of wins in the Super League giving the squad confidence and momentum heading into this trip.
